shared_elements: upright monolithic stone slab with carved low relief
row of repeated arch / inverted-U (loop-like) motifs across the upper zone
paired symmetrical elements flanking a central axis
justification: Both are tall upright carved stone blocks whose ornament is organised in horizontal registers, with a row of repeated arch/loop forms near the top, a dividing band beneath, and disc or ring motifs lower down on the broad face — a genuinely comparable compositional skeleton. The rendering, however, differs sharply: A uses shallow, crisp, largely figural relief (birds, quadrupeds, an anthropomorphic figure, a snake-like form) on pale fine-grained stone, whereas B is bold, rounded, wholly abstract/geometric relief on dark coarse stone shaped into a head-and-shoulders body, so no figural subject is actually shared.
